item.title: Karitas Anse Aux Pins: 5 Tablet pour Bann Zanfan - Seychelles Broadcasting Corporation
item.description: Bann zanfan ki form parti group Karitas Anse Aux Pins in ganny teknolozi modern pou zot lir, fer resers ek etidye. Sa group in resevwar 5 tablet avek lakonpannyen ‘Noble Con’.

item.title: 'Mobile for Goods’: Nouvo Proze Ledikasyon pou sansibiliz etidyan lo kimanyer pou servi teknolozi - Seychelles Broadcasting Corporation
item.description: Minister Ledikasyon i lans en nouvo proze apele “Mobile for goods” pou sansibiliz etidyan lo kimanyer pou servi teknolozi tel ki Telefonn, laptop, tablet parmi lezot dan en fason responsab pour laprantisaz.

item.title: Lotorite Lapes i anvizaze fer serten travay pou amelyor bazar pwason Rivyer Anglez - Seychelles Broadcasting Corporation
item.description: Pou amelyor nivo lizyenn kot Bazar Pwason Rivyer Anglez, Lotorite Lapes i anvizaze fer serten pti travay laba. Sa i enkli met beton dan bann landwar kot i annan makadanm.

item.title: Parti United Seychelles ti fer son motorcade Sanmdi. - Seychelles Broadcasting Corporation
item.description: Parti United Seychelles ti fer son motorcade Sanmdi. Mazorite siporter sa parti, ki’n partisip dan sa motorcade, ti stasyonen kot Maison Du Peuple kot tou ti konmanse.

item.title: Peryod kanpany - Seychelles Broadcasting Corporation
item.description: Komisyon Eleksyon i fer rapel tou dimoun ki, dapre lalwa eleksyon, peryod kanpany i terminen 24 erdtan avan ki vote i komanse.

item.title: Miz-a-zour lo rol lapolis dan eleksyon - Seychelles Broadcasting Corporation
item.description: Asistan Komisyoner Lapolis, Antoine Desnousse, i donn en miz-a-zour lo rol lapolis dan eleksyon ki pour fer sa wikenn.

item.title: Biro Komisyon Eleksyon in sertifye rezis voter pou sa lannen - Seychelles Broadcasting Corporation
item.description: Depi semenn pase, Biro Komisyon Eleksyon in sertifye rezis voter pou sa lannen, kot ofisyelman i annan 77,045 dimoun ki kapab vote.
